method: Only items.json, six designated artifact directories, original core private criteria and rubric; local source/transcript and audited effect-free .cjs execution. No browser, servers, network, headless rendering, installs, target skill, maps or original worklogs.

status_vocabulary.pass: Directly observed transcript fact, artifact existence or successful local-check execution; never a browser pass.
status_vocabulary.source-supported: Implementation/logic supported by inspection and/or mock checks, with native acceptance unobserved.
status_vocabulary.fail: Contradiction or broken required outcome directly demonstrated.

scores_note: All dimensions are provisional source/transcript scores. Functional and creative scores are limited to 2 by missing native/rendered evidence, not proof of product defects. No total or condition effect inferred.
policy_incidents: Root handles incident adjudication/invalidation separately; this review neither reconstructs incidents nor accepts historical browser claims.

human_direction_and_answer_fidelity.evidence: Source implements supplied direction; available transcript contains no contradiction or unanswered consequential requirement.
human_direction_and_answer_fidelity.qualification: source/transcript-limited; not a full acceptance score

functional_completion_states_and_recover.evidence: Core transitions are supported by source and mocked local checks; rendered behavior and native browser semantics remain unobserved.
functional_completion_states_and_recover.qualification: source/transcript-limited; not a full acceptance score

creative_relevance_and_scope_fit.evidence: Product-relevant hierarchy/copy/layout intent is evident in source; visual success and usability cannot be assessed without rendering.
creative_relevance_and_scope_fit.qualification: source/transcript-limited; not a full acceptance score

necessary_friction_and_autonomy.evidence: Available excerpts show focused consequential questions where needed, or direct execution when the brief/delegation is sufficient; final artifact and local logic evidence exist.
necessary_friction_and_autonomy.qualification: source/transcript-limited; not a full acceptance score

missed_details: No demonstrated critical source-level omission. Added contact notes, local persistence and mandatory recorded-contact gate are broader than minimum requested. Gate also applies to Ready orders; interpret this as a design assumption, not a demanded requirement. It is documented and locally recoverable.

Collection is a direct action after contact rather than confirmation dialog; user asked separate/deliberate collection, not a mandatory confirmation modal. Do not penalize this difference without usability evidence.
limitations: Conversation excerpts are coordinator summaries, not full native tool traces; source inspection claims, elapsed effort and every intermediate action cannot be independently reconstructed.
All visual, viewport, native keyboard, focus visibility, dialog behavior, contrast and actual browser-console acceptance are unobserved. Prior runner browser claims are excluded for every artifact.
Mocked DOM checks bypass HTML parsing, actual selector matching, native events and layout; synthetic success is evidence about logic paths, not browser correctness.
